title: Rajasthan Gets 2.89 Lakh PMAY-G Houses
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan sanctioned 2,89,355 pucca houses worth ₹3,473 crore for Rajasthan under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) on 17 August 2026. The approval letters were handed over at a state-level PMAY-G eve...

blocks.content: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan sanctioned 2,89,355 pucca houses worth ₹3,473 crore for Rajasthan under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) on 17 August 2026. The approval letters were handed over at a state-level PMAY-G event in Baran, Rajasthan, to Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma.

items: PMAY-G stands for Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin and covers rural housing assistance.
PM-RKVY stands for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana and relates to agricultural development.
Pucca houses are permanent houses built with durable materials such as brick, cement, and concrete.
Rajasthan is one of India’s largest states by area and has a large rural population.
